name: myelinate
description: Learn anything and learn it well: a class, a language, an instrument, a trade, a codebase. Myelinate teaches one step at a time, checks what you can do yourself, gives honest verdicts and brings ideas back before you forget. Practice, flashcards, figures and videos with pause questions, in the conversation where your assistant can draw them. Assignment coaching teaches instead of doing the work. It keeps nothing about you.
